caption: The drawing depicts a stylized eagle with outstretched wings, predominantly colored in shades of yellow and brown. The eagle's body is shield-shaped, and within this space, the name "Townsend" is inscribed in a cursive script. The eagle's head is turned to its left, and its beak is closed. From under the eagle's wings, a ribbon or banner extends downward and loops beneath the shield, with both ends spreading out to either side. Each talon of the eagle holds a branch; the left side (from the viewer's perspective) appears to be a cluster of arrows, while the right side holds an olive branch. The background is a light tan color, and the image is framed with a rectangular decorative border. There are numbers and text (“N.Y. 10,026 – ME. 12”) printed in the upper right and lower right corners.
title: Door Knocker
